summary: Farmmi, Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting final voting results of its annual meeting of shareholders for fiscal year 2025. Proposals approved include re-election of directors, ratification of YCM CPA Inc. as auditor, increasing board size from five to seven, and a share consolidation (reverse split) within a range of 1-for-5 to 1-for-250 at the board's discretion. The filing is a routine event-driven report of ordinary shareholder votes and does not constitute a special situation. No deal terms, premium, or strategic event are present.
